title: Shipping rate shopping: a timeout that depends on the callee cooperating
name: Carrier rate timeouts

questions.prompt: During Midwest Freight's outage this morning, checkout hung on the "Calculating shipping..." spinner until the load balancer cut the request off at 60 seconds. That happened even though every carrier call is supposed to be limited to 800 ms and slow carriers skipped. When ShipFast was slow last week, checkout skipped it just fine. Fix shipping/timeout.ts so the tests pass.
